title: App UI kit
description: One app's real UI (composer, '+'/'/' menu, chips, working state, result views) captured from the live DOM, so a motion template's prompt box looks 1:1 like the app the narration is prompting (Jake 2026-10-09). Loaded by aieditor/uikits.py (load/for_app/scene_kit): app must equal the folder name, composer.{html,css,width,height} are required, and the whole kit is screened for private text (RULEBOOK C7). Strings may hold {{file:assets/x.svg}} and any item may name "icon": "assets/x.svg"; scene_kit() inlines both. Templates scope every css rule under .kit-<app> (so never put a comma inside :has()/:is(), never use @keyframes; drive animation with CSS variables per frame) and fill html with {{key}} (values escaped unless the key ends in _html; unknown keys become empty).

app.description: = the folder name under ui-kits/; never another app's UI

hosts.description: site hosts this kit is for (uikits.app_for_url)

theme.description: the theme Jake records this app in (RULEBOOK S7: ChatGPT dark)

source.description: "live DOM" (logged in), "public DOM" (logged-out page) — never invented

fonts.description: {CSS family: file in motion/fonts} (free/OFL substitutes; the licence file sits beside the font)

font_real.description: the app's real font stack and why the substitute was chosen

tokens.description: CSS custom properties (--<prefix>-*) the template sets on the kit root

width.description: natural CSS px width (templates scale it to the reference composer's on-screen width)

height.description: natural height of the default (empty / single-line) state

multiline_over_px.description: text wider than this → the app's multi-line layout

html.description: fills {{prompt}} {{placeholder}} {{chips_html}} {{state_html}} (+ kit-specific optional ones, listed in fill)

fill.description: every {{key}} the html takes and what to pass

item_html.description: fills {{icon_html}} {{label}} (+ optional {{desc}}); its FIRST element is the row (hover_class toggles on it)

items.description: the app's REAL rows in their live order; templates match narration labels to them for the icon

private_check.description: what was verified so the kit holds nothing private beyond the display name 'Jake Dawson' (RULEBOOK C7)
